blind_spots_patched: Baseline ch-3 omitted three 10-K/10-Q concentration risks: (1) top two resellers accounted for 52% of total Accounts Receivable at YE2025 (up from 50% at YE2024); (2) Arista holds no guaranteed supply or exclusivity contracts with sole predominant silicon vendor Broadcom or its three EMS partners (Jabil, Sanmina, Foxconn), while Broadcom supplies identical Tomahawk chips to white-box ODMs; and (3) contract-manufacturer cash deposits nearly tripled (+188%) from $53.0M to $152.8M alongside tariff exposure in Malaysia, Vietnam, and Mexico.

Baseline ch-4 overlooked vertical scale-up encroachment via NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to custom XPUs, NVIDIA's expanded Spectrum-X/BlueField-4 collaboration with Meta, the NVIDIA-Cisco USFP optical partnership, and FY2025 10-K warnings on price-focused Asian/Chinese rivals (Huawei, Accton/Edgecore, Celestica) plus hyperscaler disaggregated hardware/software procurement.

Baseline ch-5 omitted (1) Q4 2026 & Nov 13–20 insider Form 4/144 sales (Bechtolsheim 300k sh Nov 18 / 1.69M sh over 3 months under 10b5-1; Ullal 715.9k sh Oct sales + 890k sh Nov 17 gift; Director Lewis Chew 2,500 sh non-10b5-1 sale Nov 13; Duda, Breithaupt, Templeton sales; new Q3 10b5-1 plans for COO Nightingale and three directors) while buybacks paused at $0; and (2) June 2025 hiring of President & COO Todd Nightingale ($30M RSU/PSU package) and Sept 2025 elevation of Kenneth Duda to President & CTO.

Baseline ch-6 contained placeholder 9M 2026 cells and missed four balance-sheet/footnote items in Q3 2026 10-Q: (1) customer-site evaluation inventory more than doubled (+116.6%) from $403.7M to $874.3M alongside $1,586.2M deferred COGS; (2) $1.7B unamortized RSU compensation (24.3M unvested RSUs over 4.1 yrs) with basic shares rising +6.9M while buybacks stayed at $0; (3) $135.8M non-operating strategic investment gain inside Q3 Other Income; and (4) $(117.2)M gross unrealized AFS bond losses in AOCI.
